name: wifi-network-monitor
readme_sample: # WiFi Network Access Monitor  A lightweight Flask web app for monitoring devices on a local WiFi network, approving trusted devices, and logging suspicious access.  ## Features  - Login with hashed passwords and session protection - Local IPv4 network scanning every 20 seconds when monitoring is enabled - Device table with IP address, MAC address, hostname, vendor, and status - Device type examples such as Router/Gateway, Laptop/Desktop, Mobile device, and Network device - Manual authorization
